title: Self-Confidence
coreMove: Trust your prepared judgment long enough to keep thinking when the room presses back.
sourcePressure: Self-confidence stabilizes independent judgment after self-knowledge and self-control. It is grounded self-trust under social pressure, not ego, charisma, or performance.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Confusing confidence with ego, certainty, charm, or ignoring contrary evidence.

sourceAnchors.name: independent judgment under social pressure
sourceAnchors.detail: the heading index supports self-confidence through independent judgment, social pressure, trusting yourself, and steadiness
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Grounded confidence is quiet enough to hear the room and steady enough not to borrow its answer.

hook: first sentence that says clear thinking is about slowing down
counterintuition: most people think self-confidence is simple
not X but Y negation shell
